info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Corporate Finance Engagements API
info.description: The Corporate Finance Engagements API facilitates the initiation of engagement records related to mergers and acquisitions transactions. This API allows businesses to capture and manage essential engagement details, ensuring an organized approach to corporate finance activities. Common users include financial institutions, investment firms, and corporate finance teams that seek to streamline their M&A processes. With this API, users can submit new engagement requests that form the basis of collaboration and project management in mergers and acquisitions.

post.summary: Create a new engagement for mergers and acquisitions.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new engagement within the corporate finance mergers and acquisitions domain. Provide the necessary details to initiate the engagement, and receive a confirmation upon successful creation.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a new engagement for mergers and acquisitions within the corporate finance domain. It should contain all necessary details such as client information, transaction specifics, and any relevant financial data.
